svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · DISTRIBUTED CHECKPOINTING ENGINE ARCHITECTURE (#365)
PyTorch Async DCP vs. Megatron-Core DistCkpt vs. JAX Orbax (6.4 TB State)
Zero-Overhead CUDA Stream D2H + NVMe Burst Buffer cuts 6.4 TB checkpoint GPU stall from 480s to 0.25s (99.98% Goodput)
• All 1,024 GPUs block while Rank 0 gathers & serializes 6.4 TB
• Single-node NIC/RAM bottleneck: 13.3 GB/s write throughput
• Rigid world_size: fails to load if cluster shrinks from 1024 to 960
Tier 4: Async CUDA Stream D2H + NVMe + DCP/Orbax
• Stage 0: Background CUDA Stream copies HBM -> Pinned DRAM
• Stage 1: Background process flushes DRAM -> Local NVMe in 1.2s
• Stage 2: Elastic DCP/Orbax metadata enables N-to-M Resharding
4-Tier Distributed Checkpointing Matrix (1,024 GPUs · 6.4 TB Checkpoint Every 30 Min)
Tier 1 (Rank-0 torch.save) : Stall = 480.00s | BW = 13.3 GB/s | Reshard = No | Goodput = 76.90%
Tier 2 (Sync Sharded DCP / Orbax) : Stall = 38.00s | BW = 168.4 GB/s | Reshard = Yes | Goodput = 97.90%
Tier 3 (Pinned-RAM Two-Stage Async): Stall = 1.80s | BW = 185.0 GB/s | Reshard = Yes | Goodput = 99.90%
